rationale: Both blocking findings from code-review.final are resolved by the fix-up diff. CR-001: BaseAgentAdapter.ts's dry-run branch now wraps the print in try/finally and stops this.proxy (setting it back to null) before returning — confirmed against the actual patch hunk at BaseAgentAdapter.ts:584-600, and covered by a new regression test ('stops the proxy before returning when the profile uses SSO/JWT auth') that sets CODEMIE_PROVIDER: 'ai-run-sso' and asserts the mocked proxy.stop() was called and this.proxy is null afterward; the fix additionally covers the error path (extractGeneratedConfig throwing) since finally runs regardless. CR-002: config-redaction.ts's SECRET_KEY_PATTERN is broadened to api[-_]?key|private[-_]?key|token|secret|password|credentials?|authorization, and a new test confirms 'x-api-key', 'password', 'privateKey', and 'credentials' are all now masked while an unrelated key ('X-Trace-Id') is left untouched. No new high-risk issue is suspected in the fix-up itself — it is a small, narrowly-scoped patch (try/finally + regex broadening + test-only changes to fix a test mock's constructibility and an ambient-env leak guard) with no new external interfaces, no new dependencies, and no changes to error-handling contracts beyond the two findings being fixed — so the scoped blind+edge-case confirmation pass was not dispatched. Full unit+cli-integration suite re-run after the fix-up: 2740 passed, 11 skipped, zero failures.
